results.title: Official 26-Man 2026 Panama World Cup Roster & Printable PDF - Sports Brackets
highlights:
Head coach Thomas Christiansen has named the official 2026 Panama World Cup roster – the 26-man squad that will represent Panama at the FIFA World Cup co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico. The roster was announced on Tuesday, May 26, 2026, at the Panama Canal Administration Building, locking in the players who will chase glory on the biggest stage in soccer.
[...]
Below is the complete 26-man roster grouped by position with each player’s current club, our projected Starting XI, the free printable PDF checklist, and quick links to Panama’s schedule, the live group standings, and the rest of the 48-team field.

### Panama’s Tactical System: The 3-5-2 That Makes Them Hard to Beat
[...]
Orlando Mosquera is expected to start in goal, protected by a back three likely comprising Andrés Andrade, Fidel Escobar (if fit), and Carlos Harvey. The system relies heavily on the wing-backs for width and ball progression, with Amir Murillo on the right and Eric Davis on the left. In central midfield, captain Aníbal Godoy and Adalberto Carrasquilla will be expected to partner up.

Projected: spirited group-stage campaign; a first-ever World Cup win is the realistic ambition, with knockout qualification a long shot.

results.title: South Korea at the 2026 World Cup: Son Heung-min's Last Dance with Hong Myung-bo | Fanorate
highlights:
South Korea 2026 World Cup guide: Hong Myung-bo’s squad, captain Son Heung-min, Lee Kang-in, Kim Min-jae, Group A predictions and the Taeguk Warriors’ knockout hopes.
[...]
South Korea are arguably the second-strongest team in Group A behind hosts Mexico, and reaching the knockout rounds is the clear primary goal. Statistical projections have given them roughly a coin-flip-to-better chance of advancing from the group. With the expanded format and a squad boasting elite European talent, qualification for the Round of 32 is the expectation, with the Round of 16 a realistic ambition.
